senses.definition: A public internet cafe where people can meet to play multiplayer computer games for a fee.
senses.example: In South Korea, mobile phones have created a new population called transyouths who connect to each other through screens and PC bangs (J.H-j. Choi, 2010).

senses.definition: A removable memory or I/O device that fits into an expansion slot on a notebook computer or a personal digital assistant (PDA). PC Cards are used primarily in notebook computers and PDAs. PC Card peripherals include Wi-Fi network cards, memory cards, modems, wired NICs, and hard drives.
Synonym of personal computer (“a PC-compatible computer”)
Nationwide computer networks that preceded the World Wide Web/Internet, with telnet-based dial-up connections and bulletin board messaging systems.
senses.example: Financial cyber trading in Korea has been increasing steadily in the areas of stock trading and banking via telephone networks, modem-based PC communication and the Internet.

senses.definition: A policeman (implying that he is dull and slow).
An act in which a user intimidates or harasses another into changing their personal opinions because they do not consider them politically correct enough.
A device found in most IBM PC compatible computers that allows simple beeps to be output.
A high-speed serial computer expansion bus standard, designed to replace the older PCI, PCI-X and AGP bus standards.
